claims: A colon-prefixed title can remain an ordinary article when that namespace is not configured locally.
File and category namespaces change link behavior, so namespace conversion requires independent source context.
English canonical namespaces and configured local aliases already work natively.

boundaries: A foreign file prefix is eligible only with a complete literal filename whose extension is supported natively.
Only an image option in the same proved source-language namespace6 and image magic group may migrate.
Unknown bare or key-value words under already native file prefixes remain literal captions.
Foreign category prefixes remain unchanged without an exact source-bound existing native category14 target receipt and isolated footer placement.
Native accepted namespace aliases and image options retain their raw spelling.
